answer: An agent economy can bind identity to a unique physical sensor fingerprint, treating each device's raw waveform as a cryptographic signal that is costly to clone. We embed a per-agent pigment of anisotropic elastic parameters into GPU-accelerated boundary element simulations, so honest nodes emerge from the meadow of peers only when their discretized wavefields match. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(Delta * S) capital forfeiture.
